in_sanskrit.name: Rajo
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Joy, Happiness
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Rajo एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Rajo is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rasayanam' which means 'to bring joy'. It is also associated with the Sun god, signifying royalty, power, and happiness.
